scope: Twenty-four instrumented exported journeys on one Windows runner, four repetitions in AB/BA/AB/BA order. Fresh means empty user data, not cold OS caches; retained New Acc uses its own fresh output; every Load uses the same r1-baseline-fresh profile. Inclusive costs overlap and must not be summed. Screenshot hashes establish integrity; visual review remains required. Four samples per variant/case are descriptive, not statistical certainty.

source.scope: Matched baseline/candidate instrumented exports on one Windows runner. Each action starts a new process. Retained uses own fresh output; every Load uses r1-baseline-fresh. OS caches are not cleared.
